race.comment: AUXILIARY (4) sets the standard after a strong Katherine BM70 win, scoring by over three lengths as a well-backed favorite following a solid fourth in BM NT at Darwin. Returning after four months and racing in Alice Springs for the first time, his perfect 1100m record, Lek Maloney's claim, and a strong jockey-horse combo put him on top. REAL VALENTIA (6) poses a danger in current form, having beaten Yule Point by three lengths in a BM64 here, with three wins and three placings from twelve starts at this track and distance, despite the grade rise. BOY BIG (5) ran in Open company, finishing fifth behind Limited Risk, and gets weight relief with Paul Denton back aboard, but he seems more suited for a place. FLYING YISHU (2), second to Limited Risk in Open grade, has three wins and two placings from six at this track and distance, making him an upset chance.
